description: Classic American cooking centers on salt and pepper, potatoes, and butter. Regional pride — smoke, cast iron, and generous portions with table-side adjustment.

attributes.micro_lesson: Smoke and spice rubs, fond from cast iron, vinegar or hot sauce at the table for balance.
attributes.shopping_tip: Cast iron, BBQ sauce, chili powder, and good black pepper.
flavor_building: Start with butter as your cooking medium.
Season with salt and pepper — toast or bloom in fat when using ground spices.
Build the plate around potatoes as the anchor.
cultural_notes: Respect Classic American food as living tradition — learn context, not just copycat recipes.
Ask Clara for dish matches from our 568K+ recipe corpus filtered to this cuisine.
